amber.benefit: Provides working candidate CSV extraction with bounded pagination and contributor/license columns.
amber.source: Local offline execution of unchanged Python fence in amber/answer.md; official iNaturalist API source https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaturalist/iNaturalistAPI/main/lib/views/swagger_v1.yml.ejs
amber.location: Python fence; API license enum lines 2306-2320, privacy lines 2598-2636
amber.why_material: Reduces manual JSON-to-CSV work. Fixture execution created the expected columns and longitude/latitude order. It deliberately remains a candidate exporter; manual screening remains required.

teal.benefit: Names a bounded two-species starter scope instead of leaving every species native-status determination to the reader.
teal.location: Virginia publication introduction/carpenter bees, PDF page 1; eastern guide Bombus impatiens species section pages 14-17
teal.why_material: The Virginia source explicitly includes Xylocopa virginica among native bees and the eastern guide supports Bombus impatiens identification/range. This is a useful modest reduction of checklist review; not proof of local occurrences or complete coverage.

verification_limits: Live API reads failed independently through both web and local urllib: web reported inaccessible URLs; urllib reported Errno 8 DNS resolution failures. This corroborates present environment limitations, not an exact historical tool trace or worldwide API outage.

No live regional harvest, QGIS execution, PDF rendering, scheduler, literature recall or deduplication accuracy measurement was possible. Recommendations and synthetic fixture checks are distinct from successful real-data operation.

Only assigned packets and protocol were inspected. Original answers and evidence were preserved. No accounts, installs, credentials, remote writes, other reviews or arm identity information were used.
